en_quote: bisulfite treatment (Figure 1a; pending orthogonal
jp_quote: bisulfite処理によって5mCと区別できない(オルソゴナルな化学的確認待ち
issue: EN cites Figure 1a at the 4mC-vs-5mC claim; the JP parenthesis drops the figure cross-reference entirely, leaving the central 4mC reassignment sentence without its figure pointer.
proposed_fix_jp: 「(Figure 1a;オルソゴナルな化学的確認待ち;Limitationsを参照)」と Figure 1a を補う。

en_quote: regulatory genes ... regulatory/TF gene neighbourhoods
jp_quote: 制御遺伝子 / 制御性遺伝子 / 調節遺伝子 / 調節性遺伝子
issue: EN uses one term, 'regulatory gene(s)', throughout R2/R3. JP alternates four renderings: R2 body uses 制御遺伝子/制御性遺伝子, the R2 last paragraph uses 調節遺伝子, and R3 uses 調節性遺伝子/調節因子. A reader cannot tell these are the same 1,051-gene set.
proposed_fix_jp: 全文で「制御遺伝子」(初出のみ regulatory genes 併記)に統一する。

en_quote: depleted from promoter-proximal regions
jp_quote: プロモーター近接領域から減少 … GCCGGC枯渇
issue: EN 'depletion' is rendered as 減少 in the R2 heading and first half, and as 枯渇 from the mechanism paragraph onward (and 枯渇 again in R2's last paragraph and R3). Same concept, two Japanese terms in one section.
proposed_fix_jp: 「枯渇(depletion)」に統一し、見出しも「…プロモーター近接領域で枯渇しており」とする。

en_quote: Developmental dynamics of protection zone architecture were informative
jp_quote: 発生動態的なprotection zone architectureは示唆に富むものであった
issue: EN 'were informative' is a neutral statement about the data; JP 示唆に富む ('rich in implications') reads as a stronger interpretive claim, and the JP also re-attaches the adjective to the architecture rather than to its dynamics.
proposed_fix_jp: 「protection zone architecture の発生動態は情報量に富むものであった」

en_quote: Vegetative-phase GCCGGC methylation thus preferentially marks the promoters
jp_quote: 栄養増殖期のGCCGGCメチル化は…プロモーターを優先的に標識していると考えられる
issue: EN states this as a flat conclusion from the enrichment result; JP adds と考えられる, weakening a directly measured statement into an inference. Hedge strength differs on the JP side.
proposed_fix_jp: 「…プロモーターを優先的に標識している。」(と考えられる を削除)

en_quote: hereafter GCCGGC-proximal
jp_quote: 以下GCCGGC近接 … GCCGGC近傍遺伝子セット
issue: JP defines the abbreviation as GCCGGC近接 but every subsequent use in R5 and R6 is GCCGGC近傍 (and AAGCCCG近傍). The defined term is never used again, so the JP text appears to introduce a second set.
proposed_fix_jp: 定義を「以下GCCGGC近傍」に変更するか、以降の出現をすべて「GCCGGC近接」に統一する。

en_quote: dual-targeted (within 2 kb of both; n = 443)
jp_quote: デュアルターゲット … 二重標的化された遺伝子セット … 二重標的化遺伝子セット
issue: EN uses 'dual-targeted' consistently; JP uses katakana デュアルターゲット at the definition and 二重標的化(された) thereafter.
proposed_fix_jp: 「二重標的化(dual-targeted)」を定義時に置き、以降統一する。

en_quote: We emphasise that this is a statement about *where*
jp_quote: ただしこれは2つのメチル化システムがゲノム上の*どこ*に配置されているかについての記述であって
issue: EN's authorial emphasis ('We emphasise that') is dropped in JP in favour of a plain concessive ただし. This is the sentence that fences the enrichment result off from a regulatory claim, and the emphasis is load-bearing for the permissive thesis.
proposed_fix_jp: 「強調しておきたいのは、これは…についての記述であって、濃縮された経路の転写制御を意味するものではないという点である。」

section: Methods / 効果量の推定と検出力
en_quote: non-parametric bootstrap with 10,000 resamples drawn with replacement
jp_quote: 10,000回の非復元でないブートストラップ再抽出(復元抽出)により算出し
issue: EN 'non-parametric bootstrap ... with replacement' became 非復元でない…(復元抽出) — a double negative that reads as 'not-non-replacement'. 'Non-parametric' (ノンパラメトリック) is lost and replaced by a resampling-scheme word, leaving the sentence self-contradictory as written.
proposed_fix_jp: 「95%信頼区間は、Exposed/Shieldedラベルで層別化した復元抽出による10,000回のノンパラメトリック・ブートストラップにより算出し」

section: Methods / 効果量の推定と検出力
en_quote: the smallest effect the Exposed-cohort comparison could detect at fixed power
jp_quote: 実際の実現サンプルサイズ下でExposedコホートにおいて検出可能な最小効果量を推定した
issue: EN qualifies the MDE as being 'at fixed power'; JP omits the fixed-power condition, so the JP sentence does not state what the minimum detectable effect is minimal with respect to.
proposed_fix_jp: 「…実現サンプルサイズ下で、検出力を固定したときにExposedコホート比較が検出しうる最小効果量を推定した」

en_quote: Withdrawn for the same reason as Supplementary Figure 2
jp_quote: Withdrawn for the same reason as Supplementary Figure 2 (distance-classifier AUCはnon-circularな定義の下では自明であるため)。
issue: The JP legend's opening clause is left verbatim in English; only the parenthetical was translated. JP file line 388.
proposed_fix_jp: 「Supplementary Figure 2 と同じ理由により撤回した(non-circular な定義の下では distance-classifier AUC は自明であるため)。」

section: Supplementary Figure 21 legend, panel (a) (EN L449 / JP L481)
en_quote: because site positions turn over completely between timepoints
jp_quote: サイト位置がタイムポイント間で完全に入れ替わるためである
issue: Both languages carry the pre-Story-A claim that GCCGGC site positions turn over completely between timepoints. Locked canon: GCCGGC 4mC T1-T2 Jaccard 0.700 (1,188 shared sites), 56 of 62 Exposed promoters retain a site at T2 — i.e. the methylome is largely stable, not fully turned over. This sentence also supplies the justification for the 1,659/1,078 'union' framing in the same parenthesis.
proposed_fix_jp: 当該理由節を削除し、EN と併せて「この集合は各モチーフ文脈内で 4mC と 6mA をプールした T1 の部位数であり、本文の canonical census(T1 GCCGGC 4mC 1,289 部位)とは定義が異なる」と定義差に書き換える(著者判断)。

section: Supplementary Figure 21 legend (EN L435 vs L449 / JP L467 vs L481)
en_quote: T1 sites, 4mC and 6mA pooled within each motif context … high-confidence methylation sites (unique positions pooled across all three timepoints)
jp_quote: T1の部位について、各モチーフコンテキスト内で4mCと6mAをプールし … 高信頼メチル化サイト(全3タイムポイントにわたる固有位置をプールしたもの)
issue: The same two counts (n = 1,659 and n = 1,078) are defined twice within one legend and the definitions contradict: the convention note says T1 sites, panel (a) says a union pooled across all three timepoints. Identical contradiction in EN and JP, so it is not a translation error but it propagates to both. Supplementary Figure 9 (EN L382 / JP L412) states the T1 definition.
proposed_fix_jp: パネル(a)の「全3タイムポイントにわたる固有位置をプールしたもの」を「T1の部位」に統一する(Supplementary Figure 9 の規約に合わせる)。

section: Supplementary Figure 21 legend, panel (a) (EN L449 / JP L481)
en_quote: GCCGGC 4mC (*n* = 1,659 sites) and AAGCCCG 6mA (*n* = 1,078 sites)
jp_quote: GCCGGC 4mC(*n* = 1,659 sites)およびAAGCCCG 6mA(*n* = 1,078 sites)
issue: Panel (a) labels the two sets as modification-specific (GCCGGC 4mC, AAGCCCG 6mA), but the same figure's convention note and Supplementary Figure 9 state these counts pool 4mC and 6mA within each motif CONTEXT (GCCGGC: 1,313 4mC + 346 6mA; AAGCCCG: 674 4mC + 404 6mA). Same mislabel in EN and JP.
proposed_fix_jp: 「GCCGGCコンテキスト部位(*n* = 1,659)およびAAGCCCGコンテキスト部位(*n* = 1,078)」に改める。

section: Supplementary Figure 20 legend, panel (a) (EN L431 / JP L463)
en_quote: at T1 [author to confirm class definition]
jp_quote: T1でAAGCCCGプロモーター標識を有する22種のレギュレーター[author to confirm class definition]
issue: An unresolved author placeholder is present in the legend in BOTH languages and would ship with the submission. The definition it queries is given in Methods (EN L173 / JP L174): regulatory genes whose TSS lies within 293 bp of an AAGCCCG site at T1, n = 22.
proposed_fix_jp: プレースホルダを削除し、「T1においてTSSがAAGCCCG部位から293 bp以内にある制御遺伝子22種(Methods と同一定義)」と明示する。

section: Supplementary Figure 13 legend, panel (b) (EN L399 / JP L429)
en_quote: strand-balanced — consistent with passive, replication-coupled dilution
jp_quote: 鎖間でバランスが取れていた ― これは受動的な複製共役性希釈と一致する所見である
issue: Both legends attribute the hemi-methylation to passive replication-coupled dilution. Locked canon and the main text say the opposite: strand preference is fixed per site (inter-strand r = -0.92), consistent with an asymmetric recognition sequence and an uncharacterised MTase, NOT replication dilution (R0b: 'suggesting action of an uncharacterised methyltransferase'; Discussion section 'GCCGGC 4mC Exhibits Strand-Specific (Hemi-)Methylation'). Source: 91_comod_stratified_and_hemi/tables/REFA06_*.
proposed_fix_jp: 「― 修飾鎖は部位ごとに固定されており(鎖間 r = −0.92)、複製に伴う受動的希釈ではなく非対称な認識配列と整合する」に差し替える(EN も同時修正が必要)。

section: Supplementary Figure 21 legend, panel (b) (EN L449 / JP L483)
en_quote: columns correspond to the genomic-position bin (promoter, 5′UTR-proximal, CDS-internal) within each modification type
jp_quote: 列は修飾タイプ(左: GCCGGC 4mC、右: AAGCCCG 6mA)に対応する。… 各修飾タイプ…内で、列はゲノム上の位置ビン…に対応する。
issue: EN has one sentence defining the columns. JP splits it into two sentences that contradict each other: the first says columns are modification types, the second says columns are position bins within each modification type. The first clause is a JP-only addition and is wrong.
proposed_fix_jp: 前半の「列は修飾タイプ…に対応する。」を削除し、「行はエンリッチされた term に対応し、列は各修飾タイプ(左群 GCCGGC 4mC、右群 AAGCCCG 6mA)内のゲノム位置ビン(プロモーター、5′UTR 近傍、CDS 内部)に対応する。」の一文にまとめる。

en_quote: The 62 Exposed regulatory genes (non-circular definition).
jp_quote: 62個の被曝露(Exposed)制御遺伝子(非循環的定義)。
issue: Exposed is a defined class name kept untranslated everywhere else in the JP manuscript (R3, R4, Figure legends, Supplementary Table 1b). Only this title glosses it as 被曝露, which in Japanese reads as radiation/chemical exposure.
proposed_fix_jp: 「62個のExposed制御遺伝子(非循環的定義)。」

section: Supplementary Table 5 legend (EN L473-474 / JP L508-509)
en_quote: *Streptomyces* genus-level AAGCCCG and GCCGGC motif O/E statistics.
jp_quote: *Streptomyces*属レベルのAAGCCCGおよびGCCGGCモチーフのO/E統計。
issue: The title promises both motifs but the column list in both languages describes only the AAGCCCG O/E ratio and its <0.75 classification. GCCGGC O/E (median 1.00, quoted in Figure 6) has no column described.
proposed_fix_jp: 列一覧に「GCCGGCのobserved/expected比」を追加するか、タイトルをAAGCCCGのみに限定する(著者判断)。

en_quote: 92_d6_5mC_misassignment_control/`.
jp_quote: 92_d6_5mC_misassignment_control/`。。
issue: Duplicated full stop at the end of the JP legend (「。。」). JP-only.
proposed_fix_jp: 末尾の句点を一つにする。

section: Supplementary Figure 19 legend (EN L423 / JP L455)
en_quote: 44% vs 44% of Exposed/Shielded change expression
jp_quote: Exposed/Shielded とも44%が発現変動
issue: EN states the value twice as an explicit side-by-side comparison (44% vs 44%); JP collapses it to a single 44% with とも. The value is identical and not an error, but the EN construction makes the equality of the two classes explicit, which is the point of this negative control. This is the one remaining numeric-token count difference in the supplementary legends (EN has the token twice, JP once).
proposed_fix_jp: 「Exposed 44% 対 Shielded 44% が発現変動」と両側を明示する。
